definitions.baseline: Exact published stage5 engine 70387789; retained gzip, not Git HEAD.
definitions.minimumGap: Minimum sampled actual ball/selected receiver centre gap from release until resolution; acquire hook samples before normal first-touch impulse. A swept physical contact can occur between frames, so centre gap at acquisition can exceed1.10m.
definitions.resolvedTargeted: Pass-kind flights observed through the release hook (plus an existing flight at fork start), with an intended recipient, that resolve by actual acquisition, boundary restart, goal, replacement or flight clearing. Pending window-end flights are excluded. Passes created directly inside aerial(), such as headed passes, bypass release and do not enter this flight denominator; the acquisition observer still records their actual receptions.
definitions.ownLastTouchOut: Targeted flight directly resolving in throw/goal-kick/corner while passing team made last contact. It is not inferred from absence of opponent possession.
definitions.receiverInterceptionKinds: Resolved targeted ordinary pass and cutback flights. Through/cross/long-pass flights remain separately counted; this label does not infer whether a particular planner branch was invoked.
definitions.receptions: Real successful same-team pass-family acquisitions, including other-own recipients and aerial()-created headed passes, are recorded only after acquire returns true. This actual-acquisition denominator can therefore differ from release-hook flight counts. Intended prepared acquisitions require the actual target plus the same valid preparation condition as acquire (matching flight ID, age below0.55s). Planned mode comes from the pre-acquire plan; actual mode, ball impulse, body and clocks are observed after the untouched engine method returns.
definitions.actualMode: The post-acquire receiveMode is recorded without inferring success. Current cushion mode is a fallback after a real body/swept interception when the ball is outside the existing deliberate foot-contact geometry; it retains the ordinary cushioning impulse, clears the quick prepared action, and requires normal movement to recover. This label is not a completed deliberate touch or proof of improved possession.
definitions.rapidTurnover: Each actual reception opens an overlapping one-second observation window. Opponent acquisition means a later successful actual acquire by the other team within1s; opponent restart is recorded separately and is not silently counted as an acquisition. Elapsed without opponent acquisition does not imply continuous ownership: loose balls and own passes may occur. Pending end-of-window cases are reported separately; no success is imputed. Pressured means nearest current opponent is less than3m at acquisition.
definitions.contactGeometry: Geometry is read passively immediately before each actual acquire attempt from observed ball/player pose, never from an engine forecast query. The prepared intended non-GK pass/through/cutback ground subset matches the stage5 contact gate: y<=radius+0.01 and absolute vertical speed<1e-6. Foot ready means current gap<=1.20m, forward>=-0.18m and absolute lateral<=1.00m; it is not proof of a successful later deliberate touch. Contact facing turn is the absolute wrapped angle from current body face to current ball bearing; prepared facing turn is the angle to the saved preparation face. Counts summarize actual acquisitions and exclude missed flights, so they are not total pass success rates.
definitions.existingFlight: Fork snapshots may already contain a released pass. Its releaseObserved is false; its sampled gap starts at the fork, not original release.
definitions.limits: Small synthetic sample, no win target, ball/receiver repositioning, RNG forcing, hidden opponent commands or future plans. Tactical changes and preparation timing may diverge after the shared starting state.
